title: Cobblemon Shiny Redesigns
description: This project adds new shinies that blend seamlessly into the world of Cobblemon. Many Pokemon need new shinies, so different Pokemon in this resource pack will get some as time goes on.
body:
# What this mod is about?
Many Pokemon in the cobblemon game and the Pokemon universe respectively have (In some people's opinions "Bad Shinies"). This mod changes that, and redesigns said shinies.

# How fast will these shinies updated?
I'm pushing for these shinies to come out in small increments (3-5 pokemon) within 2 weeks, or maybe longer. It might take a while for the specific pokemon you want to get a shiny, or it could be one of the first, who knows?

# Gallery pictures
All pictures in the gallery will show the 3D model in block bench, but will be updated at a later time in game. Not all pokemon have pictures in the gallery, but will be updated alongside the updated quality of the photos.

# All Pokemon with new shinies SO FAR...
Falinks, Leafeon, Glaceon, Porygon-Z, Litwick Line, Wimpod Line, Charcadet Line, Gimmighoul line, Poliwag line, Dratini line, Gible line, Porygon line, and the Voltorb regular and hisuian line, 

# Trouble Shooting
If the pokemon that I have labeled aren't in a new shiny go into resource packs and make sure it's within the right active side. If it still isn't working try making a new instance with just the resource pack and the Cobblemon mod because the modpack for Cobblemon might have mods interfering with the shiny textures.
